title: The red-run hook lets an archive push through, judged on the destination ref
why: Coordinator 14:23 CST Nov 18, from the consultant's read at 14:19 CST (decision text only, no probe run): the coordinator's archive pushes were refused at 02:22 CST Nov 18 by hook `red-run`.
source: coordinator relay 14:23 CST Nov 18 (consultant's read 14:19 CST)
note: Fix: exempt a push whose destination ref starts with refs/heads/archive/, judged on the destination. Failing test first: an archive push of an old lane that is red on today's hook; control: a normal push of the same range stays refused. Home: docs/decisions/red-run-trailer-on-test-commits.md item 5, limit line 35, item 9. Prior-work search first. Mistake it stops: an unmerged lane cannot be saved before it is deleted (rule shared-trees-archive-then-delete). Harm: lost work or manual overrides.
